articles.title: Two dead after bus crashes in France, officials say
articles.summary: One child and one young adult were killed in the crash, local authorities say, with more injured.

articles.title: Judge blocks construction of Trump's massive arch after federal agency approval
articles.summary: The Trump administration had hoped the construction of the 250-foot arch could begin as early as this week.

articles.title: The crypto industry has found new ways to grow. Making money from them is another story
articles.summary: Coinbase, Robinhood and Circle are expanding into stablecoins, payments and prediction markets, but their latest earnings show how hard it is to escape crypto's boom-and-bust cycles.
